admission.justification: The members jointly preserve the user-controlled installation boundary across code, state reporting and agent-launch behavior; no individual local guard or notice prevents both wrong-root mutations and a misleading recovery/launch contract.

guarantee: Settings mutation has two independent protections: repository tests/support resolve an account-default guard before mutation even while environment patches are cleared, and installation creation/migration leaves both file and folder closed. State reporting and shell-safe user edit/close instructions expose and preserve those boundaries without any product-authored user edit.
title: Guarded tests and closed installation settings
